verdict.rationale: Remote documents an official CLI ([remote-docs-20]) that covers employments, time off, expenses, payslips, departments, custom fields, and webhook subscriptions with replays ([remote-docs-22]). Every command can emit JSON and every list command exports CSV, so output drops into scripts and agent workflows ([remote-docs-21]). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documentation of installation/authentication and explicit agent-oriented CLI features.
